newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemeni forces free German hostages, use artillery.
newsitem.headline: Yemeni forces free German hostages, use artillery.

text.p: Yemeni security forces on Sunday secured the release of four German hostages after unleashing artillery fire on their abductors' hideout and arrested the kidnappers, a senior security official said on Sunday.

The four -- two men and two women -- were taken to the Balqis Hotel in the city of Marib in Marib province in eastern Yemen. A hotel receptionist said they were in their rooms, but he had instructions from the police not to put calls through.

The official said security forces who had been besieging the kidnappers' hideout in al-Mehjezah area of Marib province fired a few artillery shells close to the rugged mountain hideout, forcing some of the kidnappers to flee.
"Seven were arrested as they fled, then the rest gave themselves up and handed over the hostages," he told Reuters.
The four Germans had been abducted by tribesmen on March 27 while returning to the capital Sanaa from Marib.
